newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo cuts Q1 loss to Dmk 10mln.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo cuts Q1 loss to Dmk 10mln.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo reduced its first quarter loss in 1997 to 10 million marks from a 40 million mark first quarter loss in 1996, Deutsche Lufthansa AG chief financial officer Klaus Schlede said.
He told a news conference that Lufthansa Cargo yields per kg were 10 percent up in the first quarter on the same period 12 months previously.
Average yield per kg had fallen by four percent in the first quarter of 1996, Schelde added.
"It is satisfying to note that our freight business is at last showing an improvement in its earnings performance," he said.
"Cargo is still in minus but it had an improvement of 30 million marks," he added.
The good first quarter was prompted by buoyant foreign trade and the weak German mark, the Lufthansa group first quarter report said.
But fuel expenses were 31.9 percent ahead of the first quarter of 1996 and fees and charges were 10.5 percent more than the same period last year, it added.
